reviews.disposition:
F1: Full actual375-line review reads every306config-system row under all13families plus the opening coverage/owner definitions. Task-local row arithmetic finds258Unread-here rows and48entries routed to S01/S03–S05/S07–S15. These are row-level links, not48independent complete systems, all15Ssections, executed mechanics or current YAIR implementation. Prior named/mentioned/D3 coverage and this pass's new trace are separate columns; undocumented-prior behavior can receive a selected trace without certifying the full family.

F2: Preserve body age/features/medicine/poison versus visual avatar/color/parts and unread Qi/disorder/lineage details; social character/party trace versus unread AI/relationships/planning/personal-needs; production material/tool/equipment trace versus unread village roles/resource/warehouse/construction; and knowledge/read/secret-information/breakthrough classes whose prior coverage remains bounded. A named stat/reference/filter is not a causal reader, and a D3profession progression body does not establish all reading, training or life-skill mechanics.

F3: Economy S08food/tea and S12merchant/caravan, institutions S03organization and S10prison/S11treasury, world S15map/route/state, combat S14artifact and minigame S13debate each point to selected system evidence, not all their neighbor configs. A travel map trace does not read every month/weather/hazard generator; a character body entry does not prove all combat skills, Neili, boss or trial behavior. Event/dialogue rows remain unread here across adventure/remake/task/story/interaction families. UI S09bubble/party links do not establish whole menu/tutorial/accessibility behavior.

F4: Content-authoring/credits/DLC/filter data and save/legacy/succession records remain separately named, not automatically new gameplay features, completed persistence or a universal fresh-life algorithm. Cricket/chicken/Jiao/Loong and other minigame names are preserved leads, with S13's debate semantics kept distinct rather than a generic tactical-game proof. Broader possible owner mappings are explicitly inferred; failure to locate a dedicated owner is a bounded documentation observation, not repository-wide absence or permission to make another framework.

F5: This readable index and its companion FAMILY_MAP are separate artifacts; the remaining JSON map is not credited as reviewed by this Markdown read. The source report's later selected source closures qualify named manufacturing/repair/medicine/prison/treasury/caravan/genome subquestions only. Full content/effects/demographics/save acceptance remain open; no config data, private extraction, ILSpy source body, installed-game state, native UI or personal save was reopened. Preserve all306rows and source-local IDs, with no guessed closures, source execution, rule uptake, worker, deletion, commit or push.
